title: Sneaker on Studio White
tests: Tests complete background replacement with seamless white while retaining white-product detail and a grounding shadow.

faults.what: The output is approximately 1.67:1 (1024 × 614), rather than the required 16:9.

judge.summary: The sneaker is cleanly isolated on seamless white with its original side view and details preserved, but the image is not 16:9.

must_haves.item: The same sneaker is shown in its original side view, fully inside the frame.
must_haves.why: The sneaker retains its side-view silhouette and is fully visible with margins on all sides.

must_haves.item: The sneaker's leather, laces and sole details remain recognizable.
must_haves.why: The leather panels, stitching, lace arrangement, and textured sole remain recognizable.

must_haves.item: The grey floor and clutter are replaced by a seamless white setting.
must_haves.why: The original floor and background clutter are gone, replaced by a plain white background.

must_haves.item: A soft shadow beneath the sneaker grounds it without introducing a visible floor boundary.
must_haves.why: A soft-edged shadow grounds the shoe, and no floor boundary is visible.

must_haves.item: The image is 16:9 with no added text.
must_haves.why: There is no added text, but the output retains the original approximately 1.67:1 proportions instead of 16:9.
